package assignments;

public class SunOfEvenNo {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		/*Sum of Even Numbers
			Write a Java program to find the sum of all even numbers between 1 and 50 using a loop.
			Expected Output:
			Sum of even numbers = 650

		 * 
		 */
		int Sum = 0;
		
		for(int i=1;i<=50;i++)
		{
			if(i%2==0)
			Sum = Sum + i;
		}
		System.out.println("Sum of even numbers between 1 to 50 is:" +Sum);
	}

}
